caption: The drawing depicts a single, rounded cup or bowl centered within a rectangular border on a beige background. The cup is rendered in shades of grey pencil, showing subtle shading to indicate curvature and light reflection. The cup has a smooth surface and an open top, with the letters "RT" inscribed on its side in a serif font. In the lower left corner of the drawing, outside the main rectangle, there is a smaller sketch of the same cup with dimensions labeled, providing a technical detail view. The artist's name, "Wester Buery," appears written in small letters in the lower right corner just inside the main rectangle. The overall color palette of the image is restricted to grayscale pencil on an off-white, slightly yellowed paper.
title: Silver Bowl
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
